problem: GitHub branch protection required only the status context test, allowing auto-merge while exact-head BRAIN or Powerhouse CodeQL were still running or red.
root_cause: The required-test aggregator covered its own delivery lanes but did not consume the terminal state of the existing sibling BRAIN and CodeQL workflows for the same candidate SHA.
prevention: Keep one native required context to avoid branch-protection fragmentation.
Before test can succeed, require completed-success BRAIN and Powerhouse CodeQL runs for the exact pull-request head SHA.
Reuse existing workflow runs through read-only GitHub Actions API calls; never duplicate expensive CI.
Fail closed on red, cancelled, missing or non-terminal critical exact-head evidence.
